startingOnDevice: Ana fara Leafen a wannan na'urar…
updatingOnDevice: Ana sabunta Leafen a wannan na'urar…
keychainAsking: macOS yana tambaya ko Leafen zai iya amfani da keychain ɗinku. Amsa a can don ci gaba.

appUpdate.ready: Leafen {{version}} ya shirya. Zai yi aiki idan kun sake kunna manhajar.
appUpdate.securityReady: Sabuntawar tsaro, Leafen {{version}}, ta shirya. Sake kunna manhajar don yin ta aiki.
appUpdate.available: Leafen {{version}} ya fito. Sabunta shi daga Microsoft Store, ko ku sauke sabon zip.
appUpdate.securityAvailable: Sabuntawar tsaro, Leafen {{version}}, ta fito. Sabunta shi daga Microsoft Store, ko ku sauke sabon zip.
appUpdate.rolledBack: Leafen {{version}} bai fara ba, don haka manhajar ta koma sigar da ta gabata da bayanan da suka kasance kafin sabuntawa.

serverKeyChanged.title: Maɓallin wannan uwar garken ya canza
serverKeyChanged.body: {{host}} ya amsa da wata sabar dabam da wadda wannan manhaja ta tuna. Wataƙila wani yana yin kamar shi ne adireshinsa don karanta haɗinka. Amince da sabuwar sabar kawai idan an tabbata mai gudanarwarta ya sake shigar da ita ba tare da ajiyarta ba.
serverKeyChanged.unvouched: {{host}} ya amsa da takardar shaidar da sabar ba ta tabbatar da ita ba. Wataƙila wani yana yin kamar shi ne adireshinsa don karanta haɗinka. Tambayi mai gudanarwarta kafin a ci gaba.
serverKeyChanged.back: Koma zuwa Leafen na wannan na'ura

serverMoved.text: An ƙaura da bayanan wannan sabar zuwa wata sabar. Ba a adana canje-canjen da aka yi a nan.
serverMoved.textNoAddress: An ƙaura da bayanan wannan sabar zuwa wata sabar. Ba a adana canje-canjen da aka yi a nan. Buɗe Leafen a adireshin sabar da ta karɓi bayanan.
serverMoved.paused: Wannan sabar ba ta iya isa wurin ajiyarta a yanzu ba, kuma sabar jiran aikinta na iya maye gurbinta, don haka ba ta karɓar canje-canje har sai ta iya.
serverMoved.standby: Wannan sabar jiran aiki ce: tana bin wata sabar, kuma ana maye gurbin bayananta idan ta karɓi aiki.
serverMoved.standbyOf: Wannan ita ce sabar jiran aiki ta {{address}}: ana maye gurbin bayananta idan ta karɓi aiki.
serverMoved.tookOver: Wannan sabar ba ta amsa ba, kuma sabar jiran aikinta {{address}} ta karɓi aiki.
serverMoved.workspace: An ƙaura da wannan wurin aiki zuwa wata sabar kuma ba ya ƙara karɓar canje-canje a nan.
serverMoved.workspaceSending: Ana ƙaura da wannan wurin aiki zuwa wata sabar kuma ba ya karɓar canje-canje a nan.

properAddress.offer: Wannan sabar yanzu tana da adireshin dindindin, {{address}}. Wannan adireshin yana aiki a nan har yanzu; ci gaba a can don amfani da shi daga ko'ina.
properAddress.failed: Ba a iya canja wurin shiga ba. Sake gwadawa, ko shiga can da lamba.

addressHandoff.carried: Leafen ya koma {{host}}; wannan na'urar ta ci gaba da shiga.
addressHandoff.passkey: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin shiga don wannan adireshin

openInApp.lead: Idan ana da manhajar Leafen, ana iya buɗe wannan shafi a cikinta.
openInApp.homeScreen: Don samun sanarwa, ƙara Leafen zuwa Allon Gidanka: Raba na Safari → Ƙara zuwa Allon Gida. Leafen da ke Allon Gida yana da nasa shiga, don haka yana shiga da lamba.
openInApp.homeScreenCode: A cikin Leafen na Allon Gida, saka {{code}} ƙarƙashin “Shiga da lamba”. Yana aiki sau ɗaya, cikin minti 10.

localReach.loopbackOnly: Wannan kwamfutar kaɗai ce ke iya buɗe wannan adireshin.
localReach.homeOnly: Na'urorin da ke kan hanyar sadarwa ɗaya ne kawai za su iya buɗe wannan adireshin.

startupRecovery.slowTitle: Leafen na jinkirin farawa fiye da yadda aka saba
startupRecovery.slowBody: Har yanzu yana farawa kuma zai buɗe kansa da zarar ya shirya. Idan hakan ya ci gaba, ajiye log ɗin ko duba babban fayil ɗin bayanai.
startupRecovery.lockedTitle: Wani shiri yana amfani da bayanan Leafen
startupRecovery.lockedBody: Wataƙila wani Leafen, ko manhajar ajiya ko daidaitawa, yana iya riƙe da shi. Rufe wannan shirin, sannan a sake gwadawa.
startupRecovery.damagedBody: Rumbun bayanai ba zai buɗe ba.
startupRecovery.diskFullBody: Leafen na buƙatar sarari a faifan da bayanansa suke. A saki ɗan sarari, sannan a sake gwadawa.
startupRecovery.failedBody: Sake gwadawa. Idan hakan ya ci gaba, ajiye log ɗin sannan a aika wa wanda ke taimakawa da Leafen.
startupRecovery.backup: An yi kwafin ajiya na ƙarshe {{when}}. Dawo da shi yana ajiye bayanan yanzu a gefe har zuwa kwafin ajiya na gaba, na tsawon kwanaki 7, don haka za a iya soke dawo da shi.
startupRecovery.noBackup: Ba a sami kwafin ajiya a wannan na'urar ba. Ajiye log ɗin kafin a canza wani abu a babban fayil ɗin bayanai.
startupRecovery.restore: Dawo da kwafin ajiya na ƙarshe
startupRecovery.restoreConfirm: A dawo da kwafin ajiyar da aka yi {{when}}?
startupRecovery.secretPrompt: An ɓoye wannan kwafin ajiya. Shigar da lambar dawo da shi ko kalmar sirri.
startupRecovery.secretWrong: Wannan ba zai buɗe wannan kwafin ajiya ba.
startupRecovery.restoreFailed: Ba a iya dawo da kwafin ajiya ba.
startupRecovery.copyFailed: Ba a iya kwafin bayanan ba.
startupRecovery.saveFailed: Ba a iya ajiye log ɗin ba.
startupRecovery.openFailed: Ba a iya buɗe babban fayil ɗin bayanai ba
